summary.best_insertion_point_C7_B: A wrapper/subclass around CONQUER.get_pred_from_raw_query using return_intermediates=True, attaching frozen-backbone RLEM heads after G/Contextual_QAL/start/end logits and before VCMR flatten/sort.
summary.existing_vs_head: Present only for similarity_measure='exclusive'; not active in general external VR-score path.
summary.existing_r2_head: No explicit R2 head in base CONQUER; RLEM C4/C6 R2-style heads are external artifacts.
summary.existing_proposal_confidence_head: No integrated proposal confidence head exists in base CONQUER.

modules.inference_usage: uses first-stage VR top-k; stores inference_vr_scores and sample_vid_name_list
